crossRefs.note: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.
As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the…
and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and…
Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.

people.name: Ataroth-addar
people.line: A town on the border of Ephraim and Benjamin.

people.name: Beth-horon_Lower
people.line: Town in Ephraim and Dan, site of a famous battle.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

translations.web: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.
translations.bsb: From there the border crossed over to the southern slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth-addar on the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.
translations.kjv: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
translations.asv: And the border passed along from thence to Luz, to the side of Luz (the same is Beth-el), southward; and the border went down to Ataroth-addar, by the mountain that lieth on the south of Beth-horon the nether.
